worldcombat.skill.vcreate.summary: Grow a scorching flame on the forehead and hurl the whole body as the projectile: the forehead fire spreads into a V and the user carries that V into the target, bursting on impact. The price is stated up front - Defense, Sp. Def and Speed all drop the moment the move is committed, hit or miss. The heaviest close-range collision in the project.
worldcombat.skill.vcreate.description.0: The blazing body deals %1$s contact damage and knocks the target %2$s blocks away.
worldcombat.skill.vcreate.description.1: Dive %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick, with a %3$s block forehead-flame radius.
worldcombat.skill.vcreate.description.2: Afterwards the user loses %1$s Defense, %2$s Sp. Def and %3$s Speed stages (paid at commit); %4$s V-flames drive the presentation.
worldcombat.skill.vcreate.nova.on: All-burn form: a heavier flame and a fuller V, at one extra Speed stage lost, longer recovery and cooldown and a slower dive - a burst that gambles mobility.
worldcombat.skill.vcreate.nova.off: Kept-flame form: a faster, longer dive and a shorter cooldown, at slightly lower flame power.
worldcombat.skill.vcreate.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.vcreate.growth.0: From level %1$s the flame rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.vcreate.growth.1: From level %1$s the flame rises to %2$s and the dive to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.vcreate.use.0: Kindle the forehead and hurl the body through one target
worldcombat.skill.vcreate.use.1: Trade in one heaviest close-range exchange
worldcombat.skill.vcreate.use.2: Gamble mobility for the top-tier burst
worldcombat.skill.vcreate.preference.nov: On: 115% flame power and a fuller V, at one extra Speed stage lost, +2 recovery, +8 cooldown, 95% dive distance and 94% dive speed. Off (kept-flame): 110% dive speed, 110% dive distance and -8 cooldown, at 95% flame power.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of diving. Larger values chase harder.

On: fire first while the user is above 60% health and the target is still sturdy, trading three stages for one heaviest exchange. Off: rank it as an ordinary close-range contact move whatever the health.
world_combat.move.vcreate.text.slump: The V gutters: Defense -%1$s, Sp. Def -%2$s, Speed -%3$s
